extracted.name: Mai tai
extracted.description: Treat yourself to a mai tai cocktail, with the flavours of rum and orange curacao. This recipe serves one, but it's easily multiplied for a party
ingredient_lines: wedge of pineapple a lime wheel or a cocktail cherry (or all three!)
instruction_lines: Pour the golden rum, curacao, orgeat, lime juice and sugar syrup into a cocktail shaker with a handful of ice cubes. Shake until the outside of the shaker feels really cold.
Fill a tumbler with crushed ice then strain the cocktail over it. Slowly pour the dark rum over the top so it stains the top of the drink a rusty gold.
Garnish with fruit like pineapple, lime and cocktail cherries if you like.
